target_customer: Creators and brands with product ideas and audiences
problem: Bringing a physical product to market takes 6 to 12 months, tens of thousands of dollars and a large team; creators lack access to capable overseas factories.
business_model: Product development and manufacturing orchestration, revenue from products sold or services, details not public
product_category: AI assisted consumer product manufacturing platform

founders.name: Lev Glushkovskii
education: NYU Stern BTE program, dropped out
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; sales and margin claims are self-reported.

founders.name: Dylan McFarland
education: NYU Stern BTE program, dropped out
previous_startups: Furniture startup bootstrapped from high school to a 40 person factory in Shenzhen (outcome not stated)

competitors.name: Arcade
competitors.what: Generative AI product creation marketplace for creators

competitors.name: Sourcify
competitors.what: Sourcing service connecting brands to factories for private label production

technical_complexity.rationale: Generative design to factory-ready specs plus supply chain matching is operationally complex; the AI part is standard.

defensibility.rationale: Factory network and creator relationships take time to build, but others (Genpire, Pietra, Sourcify) offer similar services.

market_need_then: Creators with large audiences had product ideas but no manufacturing access; the company claims it launched hundreds of products and reached creator audiences over 90M people.

branding.domain_note: Website nologo.com was serving a 404 on fetch in November 2026.

brand_strength.rationale: Playful name echoing the 'No Logo' idea, but no brand press found and it collides with a Moscow agency, a Scottish firm and the book title.

outcome_analysis: No Logo is an active Summer 2024 company with 15 people that connects creators to overseas factories. The YC page reports $5M raised to date, which is a good sign for a hardware oriented consumer company, but no round detail was verified. Its edge is creator distribution and factory relationships, which are replicable by sourcing platforms.
notes: YC page (via search summary) says $5M raised to date with new funding closed December 2025; no round breakdown, so no round recorded. CB Insights shows three fundings with a May 2025 corporate minority round from Antenna Group, unverified. Company website nologo.com returned HTTP 404. A search for outcome news returned only unrelated companies. Founder claims come from the YC page. Completeness pass 2026-11: a round closed in 2025-12 is recorded with unknown amount and type, from the company's own YC job post, which states $5M raised to date and names Y Combinator and Floodgate as backers. The remaining roughly $5M is not broken down, so the gap is known. CB Insights' May 2025 corporate minority round from Antenna Group appears to belong to a different No Logo (Scotland) and is not recorded. No independent press found.
